results.name: numeric position/size fields work without drag and persist exact layout
invalid dimensions retain the draft and do not write preferences
off-screen layout is clamped and centering remains reachable
future preference data is retained and session-only feedback is honest
snap mode alternates and synchronizes while browser writes are denied
secondary pointers cannot acquire or move a window
actual mouse drag stops after pointer cancellation and blur

limitations: Mounted real window/HUD components and real mouse/keyboard tasks; selected cancellation/secondary-pointer events are synthetic. No physical touch/pen, assistive-technology or full accessibility acceptance.
App project/history/export invariants are qualified separately on a frozen application build. No provider requests or normal browser/user storage.
